newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Norma in net 1996 profit 63 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Norma in net 1996 profit 63 mln kroons.

text.p: Leading Estonian plastics firm Norma, quoted on the over-the-counter market of the stock exchange, said that it made a net profit of 63 million kroons in 1996 on sales of 406.6 million kroons.
It did not give a 1995 comparison. Earlier this month it forecast a 1997 profit of 50.2 million kroons.

The firm noted in a statement that it had won a contract to sell seatbelts for General Motors Opel Astra cars and these would begin to be supplied to an assembly plant in Poland from the start of next year.
It said that sales in its the important Russian market rose by 15 percent in 1996 compared with 1995.
The company said that the rise in sales in Russia was due to its quick reactions to changing market conditions.
Norma said that turnover in its markets in the West grew by 11.5 pct.
